requirements.title: POS specifies a stream file position in file storage units
requirements.definition: The POS= specifier specifies the file position in file storage units.

pending.pos-specifies-file-position-in-file-stor: Write distinct data to a stream file, save a POS value via INQUIRE into a nondefault integer, then use POS= with that value to read/overwrite known data; assert data recovery, not byte encoding.

requirements.title: POS is admitted for units connected for stream access
requirements.definition: POS= may appear when the data transfer statement specifies a unit connected for stream access.

pending.pos-admitted-for-stream-access-unit: Positive plan opens an external stream file, establishes a known position by INQUIRE, and uses POS= on a subsequent transfer; successful data recovery proves admitted use.

requirements.title: POS is not used for non-stream data transfers
requirements.definition: POS= shall not appear in a data transfer statement unless the statement specifies a unit connected for stream access.

pending.pos-requires-stream-access-unit: Source-control negative changes only the OPEN access from STREAM to SEQUENTIAL or DIRECT while keeping POS=; no numbered diagnostic is claimed here, and C1220 continues to own internal-file POS restrictions.

requirements.title: Processors may prohibit POS on files lacking random-positioning support
requirements.definition: A processor may prohibit POS= with particular files that lack properties necessary for random positioning, and may prohibit positioning before the current position for files lacking such support.

pending.processor-may-prohibit-pos-for-nonpositi: No portable oracle can require a particular external file or device to support random positioning; future tests use scratch/named files only after a successful stream POS probe and skip this facet if prohibited.
pending.processor-may-prohibit-backward-pos-for-: No portable oracle can require backward positioning for every file; future tests first save an inquired position and guard on successful repositioning before asserting any data effect.

requirements.title: Formatted stream POS admits the beginning and previously inquired positions
requirements.definition: For formatted stream access, POS= may specify position 1 or a value previously returned by INQUIRE(POS=) for the file.

pending.formatted-stream-pos-one-admitted: Open a formatted stream file, write known content, then use POS=1 to return to the beginning and read the first known characters; assert characters, not marker bytes.
pending.formatted-stream-inquired-pos-admitted: After writing a first chunk, INQUIRE(POS=) into an integer sentinel, write a second chunk, then use the saved POS= to reposition; assert only behavior at that saved position.

requirements.title: Formatted stream POS uses only beginning or previously inquired positions
requirements.definition: For formatted stream access, the POS= value shall be equal to either 1 or a value previously returned by INQUIRE(POS=) for the file.

pending.formatted-stream-pos-requires-one-or-inq: Source-control/status plan attempts POS=2 only after proving 2 is neither 1 nor a previously returned position for that formatted stream file; because the rule is unnumbered, no required diagnostic wording or status value is claimed.

Processor permission to prohibit positioning for files lacking necessary properties.
NOTE gives an example device/data stream; normative processor latitude is p2.
Either-form rule admits two position classes and restricts all other formatted stream positions.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.6.2.2-12.6.2.16, the individual io-control-spec specifiers (batch160). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across two rounds. Each temporary mode specifier is split into its value restriction, its one-statement effect with restoration of the connection mode (observed by INQUIRE after the statement), and the omitted-means-unchanged rule. Round 1 found a pending plan expecting exact output from I2 on a positive value without fixing the sign mode; it now uses SS, and a sweep found no other plus-, leading-zero- or rounding-dependent exact output. R1215 and C1232 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
